outcome: next pregnancy oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) results
abnormal fasting glucose in a subsequent pregnancy OGTT
cohort: Multiparous women who met inclusion criteria and gave birth between March 2020 and October 2022 were included in the study.
finding: High-intensity breastfeeding (HIBF) was associated with 47% reduced odds of an abnormal fasting glucose in a subsequent pregnancy oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT).
